title: 10 Best BravesVision Games of 2026
description:
#9 Brewers at Braves
Martin Perez outduels Jacob Misiorowski, and Mauricio Dubon's two-out, bases-loaded single in the sixth delivers the go-ahead runs. Eli White throws out Jackson Chourio at the plate in the ninth as Atlanta edges Milwaukee 3-2.

title: Celebrating '95
description: June 6: The biggest offensive night of the Braves' 1995 season. Ryan Klesko hits his first career grand slam and adds a two-run shot, Chipper Jones collects four hits and a homer, and Atlanta buries the Cubs, 17-3.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
November 2
World Series Game 6 in Houston. Jorge Soler launches a 446-foot three-run homer over the train tracks, Swanson and Freeman follow, and Max Fried throws six shutout innings. Braves win 7-0 for their first title since 1995.

title: Celebrating '95
description: July 7: Tom Glavine wins it with his bat as much as his arm, driving in two runs including the go-ahead single in the sixth. Mike Mordecai's three-run homer breaks it open in the eighth as the Braves win a seventh straight, 8-4.

title: 10 Best BravesVision Games of 2026
description:
#10 Brewers at Braves
Chris Sale and Kyle Harrison trade zeros until Ozzie Albies leads off the fifth with a solo homer, then ends it in the ninth with a two-run walk-off drive off Aaron Ashby, handing the Brewers' lefty his first loss after 10 wins. Braves win, 4-3.

title: 2018 Cooperstown Roundtable
description: Atlanta Braves Hall of Fame members Chipper Jones, Greg Maddux, Tom Glavine, John Smoltz, Bobby Cox and John Schuerholz get together during the Hall of Fame induction weekend for Chipper Jones.

title: 3 Aces: Glavine, Maddux and Smoltz
description: An in-depth interview with Atlanta Braves legends and Hall of Famers Greg Maddux, Tom Glavine and John Smoltz.

title: Celebrating '95
description: October 14: Steve Avery throws six scoreless innings and series MVP Mike Devereaux caps a five-run seventh with a three-run homer as the Braves shut out Cincinnati 6-0, complete the sweep and win their third pennant in five years.

title: Celebrating '21
description:
July 4
July 4: Down 7-3 entering the ninth, the Braves rally to force extras, then win it in the most unlikely way: with the bench empty, pitcher Max Fried steps in and lines a walk-off single to beat Miami 8-7 in 10 innings.
